UNLOCK YOUR POTENTIAL
Experience a dynamic, hands-on education in fields like biology, chemistry, geosciences, physics and mathematics that will prepare you to tackle real-world challenges and take part in unparalleled research opportunities.
From research that advances health, technology and the environment to outreach that improves lives, Auburn’s College of Sciences and Mathematics puts discovery into action.

Curiosity, Applied
From classrooms and laboratories to communities across Alabama and beyond, Auburn’s College of Sciences and Mathematics brings together students, faculty and partners to ask important questions, pursue meaningful discoveries and apply science and mathematics in ways that improve lives. Through hands-on learning, innovative research and service, we prepare students to understand the world — and help shape what comes next.

Visit COSAM
Learn more about our academic programs, undergraduate research opportunities, student organizations and supportive learning community. Join us for a college tour and information session to explore COSAM spaces, connect with current students and staff, and discover how Auburn can help you achieve your goals in science and mathematics.
Schedule a Visit
an exterior shot of the sciences center classrooms
Choose Your Path
Biological Sciences
The Science of Life Starts Here
The Department of Biological Sciences provides a comprehensive education that prepares you for success in biology and related fields. With an emphasis on research, hands-on learning and mentorship from expert faculty, you’ll gain the skills to tackle today’s scientific challenges. Even as an undergraduate, you’ll have the chance to take part in unique research projects that set you apart in your academic and career journey.
Visit Biological Sciences
Biomedical Sciences
COSAM’s Biomedical Sciences program prepares students for careers in medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, veterinary medicine, optometry, physical therapy, physician assistant studies and other health-related fields. Through a strong foundation in biology, chemistry, physics and mathematics, students build the scientific knowledge and critical thinking skills needed for success in graduate and professional programs.
Biomedical Sciences
Chemistry & Biochemistry
Break it Down, Build it Better
Take advantage of COSAM’s exceptional programs in the sciences of Chemistry and Biochemistry, combining rigorous coursework with cutting-edge research opportunities. You’ll gain a deep understanding of chemical and biochemical principles while developing critical problem-solving and laboratory skills.
Chemistry & Biochemistry
Geosciences
Earth Systems from Field to Forecast
The Department of Geosciences gives you a strong foundation in understanding Earth and its natural processes. Through fieldwork, labs and research, you’ll explore geology, environmental science and atmospheric science while building the skills to address today’s environmental and societal challenges.
Geosciences
Mathematics & Statistics
Think Sharper, Solve Smarter
COSAM’s Department of Mathematics and Statistics offers a comprehensive education built on analytical thinking, problem-solving and data-driven decision-making. Our programs prepare you to tackle complex challenges and make meaningful contributions in mathematics and statistics. Along the way, you’ll gain the skills to excel in careers such as data science, finance, engineering and academia.
Mathematics & Statistics
Physics
From Quantum to Cosmos
The Department of Physics provides a rigorous education in the fundamental principles that govern the universe. Through a combination of theoretical coursework and hands-on research, you’ll explore quantum mechanics, astrophysics and materials science. Our programs prepare you for careers in research, technology, engineering or education, giving you the knowledge and skills to drive innovation and discovery.

Latest Stories
Research and Innovation
Built by hand, powered by people
Auburn's investment in a specialized attosecond lab supports cutting-edge research into the quantum world while giving students hands-on experience they can carry into science and industry after graduation.
Academics
Auburn’s first Regions-Auburn Data Hackathon
The inaugural Data Hackathon brought together students to develop data-driven solutions to a real-world lending challenge. The competition gave hands-on experience in data science, ethical decision-making and problem-solving while strengthening connections between Auburn and industry partners.
Academics
Auburn celebrates new STEM+Ag Complex
Auburn University marked the debut of its $224 million STEM + Agricultural Sciences Complex on Oct. 23, officially opening the doors to the largest academic construction project in university history and a transformational new hub for teaching, research and innovation.
Impact
How science and engineering fair is impacting lives
Science and engineering fair professional development is equipping Alabama teachers with the resources and confidence to guide future STEM leaders. With one training a domino effect occurs inspiring countless students and educators, demonstrating how one opportunity can create a lasting impact.
Impact
Invention Convention Alabama is growing
Invention Convention Alabama helps students build confidence, develop problem-solving skills and discover their potential while expanding invention education across Alabama.
Impact
At SERC, engineer Tinesha Ross reminds educators: ‘Your words matter’
At Auburn's Southern Educational Robotics Conference, aerospace engineer Tinesha “T-Bone” Ross urged educators to remember how their words can shape students' futures. The annual gathering connected robotics educators with new ideas and resources and honored Tracy Wright for expanding access to robotics education.
